'''Beryar's MK-3 rifle''' was a model of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]<ref name="Cartel Market" /> used around the time of the [[Order of Zildrog campaign]]<ref name="Cartel Market" /><ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|5.4}}</ref> and during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:SoV">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Spirit of Vengeance}}</ref>

The [[Mandalorian shock trooper]] [[Rass Ordo]] used a Beryar's MK-3 rifle during the [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|attack on the ''Spirit of Vengeance II'']]<ref name="TOR:SoV" /> and during the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]].<ref name="TOR:SoR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Showdown on Ruhnuk|Ruhnuk}}</ref>
